## Owner and reviewer

Name the implementing developer and human reviewer. Coordinate shared files before parallel work.

## Goal and approved scope

Describe the user-visible outcome. Link the relevant product-plan section and any approval/ADR.
Mark unapproved direction changes as proposals, not implementation-ready work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Specify an observable outcome and its test evidence.

## Exclusions

State what must not change, including relevant synthetic-only, privacy and architecture boundaries.

## Components and dependencies

List affected files/contracts, overlapping work, prerequisite issues and coordination needs.

## Validation plan

Identify new/updated tests, required checks from CONTRIBUTING.md and manual/device checks if needed.

## Direction and documentation

Link applicable decisions and identify documentation updates. Architectural/dependency changes require
explicit human approval; agents must not self-approve them.
